messages:
Grace: uploaded a mock called Compact-Dock that tries a different approach: invoice mini-history lives as a horizontal scroll inside the right column (instead of accordion). PTAL :mag:
Hank: interesting. horizontal scroll preserves vertical rhythm but could hide earlier months. how do users discover older invoices?
Grace: proposal: show 3 months, then a "+more" chip that opens full history in a modal. keeps page height steady and still gives quick access.
Li: accessibility note: horizontal scroll must be keyboardable (arrow keys) and have proper aria-label and role="list" for SRs. also announce when more items are loaded (aria-live="polite").
Marta: design nit: the mini-history items are tight. include icons for PDF/CSV and a compact badge for overdue amounts. ensure badge has text, not color-only.
Hank: tokens display inconsistency: left chart shows 1.2M while right rows show 1,234,567. we should unify to compact units (k/M) everywhere and expose raw counts in a tooltip. avoids cognitive mismatch.
Li: agree. tooltip should show exact raw tokens and a machine-friendly data attribute for tests.
Grace: copy: change primary button text on the invoice row to "Download" and add a small split-chevron for format choices. translations team prefers short labels.
Marta: split button is good. also microcopy under chart: "Estimated monthly spend. Final billed amount may differ." keeps expectations concise.
ux-bot: automated a11y scan: 1) legend labels fail contrast at mobile (3.6:1). 2) scope toggle lacks aria-pressed and visible focus. 3) mini-history scroll lacks keyboard focus. 4) overdue badge missing aria-label.
Grace: thanks ux-bot. fixes: bump legend text color to hit 4.5:1 at <420px, add aria-pressed and aria-label="scope toggle: org or project", make mini-history tabbable with roving tabindex, and include visually-hidden text on overdue badge ("Overdue: $X").
Hank: perf question: modal for full history could be heavy if it re-renders charts. prefer server-side pagination for history modal and client-side placeholders while fetching. also animate opacity not layout reflow.
Li: keyboard order request: DOM should be invoice mini-history -> Download split-button -> scope toggle -> chart. QA flagged a keyboard trap when popovers open in the old mock.
Marta: legend strategy: instead of +n overflow that opens a popover, try a condensed pill with a carousel dot indicator; clicking opens full legend modal. less popover complexity on small screens. thoughts?
Hank: modal for legend might be heavier than popover, but it's simpler for keyboard focus. either is fine if it doesn't trap focus and supports Esc to close.
Grace: telemetry: please add flag `billing.compact_dock` and events `billing.download_click`, `billing.format_choice`, `billing.history_more`, `billing.scope_toggled`. Run at 3% over 2 weeks to measure "time_to_download" and "history_more_rate".
Li: QA checklist: VoiceOver, NVDA, TalkBack, keyboard-only (tab/shift-tab/arrows), high-contrast theme, translations with long strings, and narrow widths 320/360/412 px. Capture focus outlines and aria-live announcements.
Marta: minor copy tweak: replace "Most recent invoice" with "Latest invoice" for brevity in the mini history item.
Grace: will update Figma: apply contrast bump, add ARIA attributes, convert history to horizontal scroll with +more modal, implement split-button, and attach annotated diffs + a short localization brief. Posting updated frames later today :raised_hands:
